newsitem.title: USA: Group raises stake in Granite Financial.
newsitem.headline: Group raises stake in Granite Financial.

text.p: A group including Kramer Spellman L.P., a Fort Lee, N.J., investment firm, said Tuesday it raised its stake in Granite Financial Inc. to 512,000 common shares, or 13.76 percent, from 471,500 shares, or 12.66 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 40,500 Granite Financial shares between Jan. 8 and Feb. 7 at prices ranging from $10.875 to $12.25 a share.
